observations.fact: IF:P passes its picture definition id and startup0 to the custom-picture routine0x770580.

Native and mobile presentations use the same original media keys and dimensions. Stable form nodes, scroll and one exit are verified on seven layouts, including native WebKit and keyboard enlargement isolation.
